items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: Seems to me Gino told me about somebody.

ctx.x: I don't think so. I don't remember.
Seems to me Gino told me about somebody. We can ask him about it. Uh-huh. Somebody with a similar name, maybe a relative or something. Do you remember Jip the Blood when they had that killing?
Oh, yes. That's, that's, that's, that's, uh, I didn't know much about him, but I, I remember the time, you know, when he, when he did do all that killing.
